scope: Observed pure-helper behavior only. These are caller-boundary findings, NOT accepted production safety results or proof an actual upstream path is exploitable.

findings.required: A strict validated input boundary must reject impossible calendar dates before freshness classification. Date.parse alone normalizes this date; helper must not serve as raw timestamp validator.

findings.input: No device_id, batch_id or sample identity; otherwise fresh synthetic values
findings.required: Validate source authorization and original batch/sample association before selecting a live reading. Helper itself cannot establish association and must not be the selection/security gate.

findings.input: connected:false plus otherwise fresh synthetic acquisition
findings.required: Track transport connected/disconnected as an independent dimension; metric freshness alone is not connection status. Do not interpret loss as physical Stop or suppress the separate disconnection warning.
